title: Marketing and market research
description: Compare competitors and substitutes in the named market before proposing positioning or a launch message.
questions: What market, audience and time window should the research cover?
What do dated product pages, release notes, public statements or filings confirm about direct competitors and substitutes?
What can the team substantiate in launch messaging, and which claims need evidence?
